nodes.text: 1  Blood arrives from the aorta through the renal arteries: a fifth of every heartbeat
2  In each kidney about a million nephrons filter it, some 180 litres a day
3  Clean blood leaves through the renal veins into the inferior vena cava
4  What's filtered out becomes urine and collects in the renal pelvis
5  The ureters carry it down to the bladder, which holds about half a litre

widgets.text: A real adult pair of kidneys from anatomical scans, with their blood supply, the ureters and the bladder. Each kidney is about 11 cm long. Cut them open or separate them to see the renal pelvis that collects urine.
